title: message
description: Input schema for the lernie built-in `message` tool (ARCH §2.11, §3.3, §3.4). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

agent.description: Recipient agent id — its full hyphenated descent, which is also its branch name and its address (ARCH §2.3). A child's address is the id its dispatch returned; the parent's address is this agent's id minus its last descent segment. The message is deposited into that agent's inbox and delivered at its next step boundary (ARCH §2.11).

content.description: The message body — content addressed to the recipient. Delivered verbatim as a user-role transcript entry at the recipient's next step boundary; steering context beside its pinned goal, not a goal rewrite (ARCH §2.8, §2.11).
